outcome: Gut microbiota composition (16s rDNA V3 and V4 regions)
cohort: Breastfed newborns diagnosed with or without breast milk jaundice were enrolled.
finding: Infants with breast milk jaundice exhibited significantly increased Streptococcus, decreased Enterococcus, increased biosynthesis of penicillin and cephalosporin, and lower levels of acetic and propionic acid in their faeces compared to controls.
cross-section timing: At the time of diagnosis of breast milk jaundice.
